description: Phase C of #407. Every statement a merged list's rows carry about one unit of a flow -- the 18.01, 18.2 and 19.1 MJ three lists give a kilogram of hard coal -- is kept in `flow_property_statements`, one row per statement per source row that reached a consensus flow, with which one the mapping converted by; the review app's flow page shows them and the spread across the substance. The substance itself gains, in `properties`, a reference value a curator chose with its reason (`flow-object-property-values.json`), the spread the lists make, and the range the class spans, kept apart. The claims hold the number of mappings converting by a statement at what phases A and B measured (63 on the builds of 779e1c4 and 1055f92), so a statement lost on the way into the table or the flow object reads as a loss, and hold each list's row count at no less than the statements its converting rows carry.

expectations.title: 63 mappings publish a multiplier derived from a property statement, as on the builds of 779e1c4 and 1055f92
expectations.comment: The 58 override rows phase A moved onto statements become 63 links because ecoinvent's six rows are merged for 3.12 and 3.8 (12 links) and one of BAFU's eleven statements converts nothing on its own target. A number below this is a statement that stopped converting; above it, a crossing that newly converts, which is a change to measure on its own.

expectations.title: Stepwise 2006's rows carry at least 24 property statements onto consensus flows
expectations.comment: Twelve energy carriers, each with the method's number and at least one of the substance block's, plus the rows whose names state their energy. Counted from `flow_property_statements`, so a list whose adapter stopped writing `property_statements`, or whose rows stopped reaching a flow, reads as a loss here.

expectations.title: AGRIBALYSE 3.2's rows carry at least 29 property statements onto consensus flows
expectations.comment: The 29 rows phase A stated, now 17 curated and 12 the vendor's, each carrying at least one statement; most fuels carry a gross and a net value.
